maintenance.changeRule: A surface inventory, channel definition, attribution decision, event contract, sensitive-data boundary, baseline claim, report claim, or completion claim may change only with an owner issue, privacy review state, validation method, and #714-linked rationale.
maintenance.closeIssueWhen: The privacy-safe measurement contract is approved, current analytics tags and owners are mapped, consent/custom-domain gaps are recorded, repository-specific implementation issues are linked, test/debug evidence confirms event semantics and consent behavior, a reproducible qualified-conversion report is linked to #714, and no success claim relies only on sessions, tag presence, or event volume.

sourcePolicy.sourceUseRule: Measurement changes must use first-party product ownership, consent authority, and debug/readback evidence. Missing referrer data remains direct/unknown and must not be inferred as AI traffic.

channelDefinitions.name: Organic search
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: Referrer or analytics source is a recognized non-paid search engine and no paid campaign marker is present.
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Do not classify answer-engine or direct traffic as organic search without observable source evidence.

channelDefinitions.name: Paid search
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: Paid campaign parameters or ad platform source identify paid search, if this channel is ever used.
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Do not infer paid search from search-engine referrers without campaign evidence.

channelDefinitions.name: Social organic
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: Referrer or campaign source identifies a social platform and no paid campaign marker is present.
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Do not treat all chat or messenger traffic as social when the referrer is absent.

channelDefinitions.name: Direct or referrer unknown
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: No reliable referrer, campaign, or source evidence is available.
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Do not infer that direct/unknown traffic came from AI search, social, or dark social.

channelDefinitions.name: Documentation referral
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: A DeGov Docs page links to another DeGov product and the referral is preserved.
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Do not overwrite the original acquisition source when cross-domain attribution preserves it.

channelDefinitions.name: Cross-product DeGov referral
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: A first-party DeGov product links to another DeGov product after the original acquisition source is known or safely preserved.
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Referral exclusion must not erase the original acquisition source.

channelDefinitions.name: AI/search-assistant referral
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: A real observable referrer or campaign source identifies an AI answer, search assistant, or citation surface.
allowedExamples: chatgpt.com when present as an observable referrer
copilot.microsoft.com when present as an observable referrer
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Missing referrer data remains direct/unknown; do not infer AI traffic from landing page, timing, or user agent alone.

channelDefinitions.name: Other external referral
channelDefinitions.classificationRule: A non-DeGov external referrer exists but does not match approved search, paid, social, docs, cross-product, or AI/search-assistant rules.
channelDefinitions.forbiddenInference: Do not reclassify external referrals into campaign channels without source evidence.

candidateJourneys.userAction: Official-site landing followed by Docs, Square, Atlas, pricing, or product engagement.
candidateJourneys.privacyNotes: No wallet, address, or authentication state is required.

candidateJourneys.userAction: Organic docs landing followed by meaningful documentation navigation or integration action.
candidateJourneys.privacyNotes: No private DAO, draft, wallet, or user profile data may be attached.

candidateJourneys.userAction: Square directory discovery followed by canonical DAO-site visit.
candidateJourneys.privacyNotes: DAO identity and target URL are allowed only when already public and canonical.

candidateJourneys.userAction: Organic, social, or AI landing on a DAO page followed by proposal directory or proposal read.
candidateJourneys.privacyNotes: Do not include vote choice, wallet address, token balance, or proposal draft data.

candidateJourneys.userAction: Proposal read followed by wallet connect or governance action intent.
candidateJourneys.privacyNotes: Measure only approved non-sensitive intent. Vote choice and wallet identity are prohibited unless separately approved and transformed for a lawful purpose.

candidateJourneys.userAction: Atlas DAO or analysis page followed by canonical DAO site, source, proposal, or methodology click.
candidateJourneys.privacyNotes: Do not profile private participants or include wallet/person identity.

candidateJourneys.userAction: AI/search-assistant or social referral followed by engaged visit or useful source navigation.
candidateJourneys.privacyNotes: AI source classification requires observable referrer or campaign evidence.

journeyDomains: representative DAO hosts from validated registry configuration
crossDomainAttribution.propertyDecision: Separate product properties or a shared property may be used only after owner and consent authority are recorded for each participating surface.
crossDomainAttribution.linkerDecision: Cross-domain linker/session behavior is allowed only when lawful, technically appropriate, and approved by each product or DAO-domain owner.
crossDomainAttribution.referralExclusionDecision: Referral exclusions may suppress self-referrals only when they preserve the original acquisition source and do not turn unknown traffic into a claimed channel.
crossDomainAttribution.customDaoDomainDecision: Custom DAO domains remain separate ownership boundaries until explicit owner, consent, and retention authority are recorded.
crossDomainAttribution.optOutDecision: Opt-out or consent state must not be silently propagated across products unless the ownership and consent basis are approved.
crossDomainAttribution.deduplicationDecision: Conversions require deterministic event IDs or session-scoped dedupe rules before aggregation.

eventContracts.name: degov_product_navigation
eventContracts.userAction: Click from official site to Docs, Square, Atlas, pricing, or product page.
eventContracts.triggeringCondition: Rendered link activation by a user.
eventContracts.consentRequirement: analytics consent or approved aggregate-only mode
eventContracts.testProcedure: Debug event readback confirms allowed parameters only and no sensitive URL payload.

eventContracts.name: degov_docs_navigation
eventContracts.userAction: Navigate from a priority docs page to another meaningful docs page, live example, or integration action.
eventContracts.triggeringCondition: Rendered docs link activation or approved integration action.
eventContracts.consentRequirement: analytics consent or approved aggregate-only mode
eventContracts.testProcedure: Debug event readback confirms topic mapping and no private payload.

eventContracts.name: degov_square_dao_click
eventContracts.userAction: Click from Square directory to a canonical DAO governance site.
eventContracts.consentRequirement: analytics consent or approved aggregate-only mode
eventContracts.testProcedure: Debug event readback confirms canonical target and public DAO identifier only.

eventContracts.name: degov_proposal_read
eventContracts.userAction: View a public proposal detail page after landing or proposal-list navigation.
eventContracts.triggeringCondition: Public proposal detail route renders successfully.
eventContracts.consentRequirement: analytics consent or approved aggregate-only mode
eventContracts.retention: requires approved retention policy and DAO-domain owner boundary
eventContracts.testProcedure: Debug event readback confirms public IDs only and no wallet/governance-sensitive payload.

eventContracts.name: degov_governance_action_intent
eventContracts.userAction: Privacy-safe wallet connect or governance action intent after proposal read.
eventContracts.triggeringCondition: Approved intent action occurs after consent and without recording outcome details.
eventContracts.deduplication: session plus dao_slug_or_public_id plus proposal_public_id plus action_type
eventContracts.consentRequirement: explicit analytics consent and owner approval required
eventContracts.retention: requires approved retention policy and privacy review
eventContracts.testProcedure: Debug event readback confirms no wallet identity, no vote choice, and consent gating.

eventContracts.name: degov_atlas_source_click
eventContracts.userAction: Click from Atlas to a canonical DAO site, source, proposal, or methodology page.
eventContracts.triggeringCondition: Rendered source or canonical link activation.
eventContracts.consentRequirement: analytics consent or approved aggregate-only mode
eventContracts.testProcedure: Debug event readback confirms target classification and no participant profiling.

eventContracts.name: degov_referred_engaged_visit
eventContracts.userAction: AI/search-assistant, social, or organic referred visit reaches an approved engaged-state threshold.
eventContracts.triggeringCondition: Observable source channel plus approved engagement threshold.
eventContracts.consentRequirement: analytics consent or approved aggregate-only mode
eventContracts.testProcedure: Debug event readback confirms direct/unknown is not reclassified as AI and query strings are stripped.

baselinePlan.storageRule: Save the dated baseline in an approved issue, repository artifact, or measurement workspace before instrumentation changes.
baselinePlan.analysisRule: Compare event semantics, consent behavior, attribution preservation, and conversion quality. Do not treat total sessions, tag presence, or event volume as the success condition.

repositoryFollowUps.scope: Map current official-site analytics/consent state and implement approved product-navigation events only after owner and retention approval.
Map docs analytics/consent state and implement approved meaningful-navigation events only after owner and retention approval.
Verify current GA property ownership and implement approved Square-to-DAO discovery events without private payloads.
Map registry DAO tag configuration, custom-domain ownership, consent behavior, and implement approved proposal-read or action-intent events without wallet/vote payloads.
Map Atlas analytics/consent state and implement approved source-navigation events without participant profiling.

forbiddenSuccessClaims: direct traffic assumed to be AI
wallet/vote data used as conversion proof

validation.rollback: Disable or revert the affected instrumentation if consent behavior, owner authority, event semantics, attribution preservation, or sensitive-payload exclusion cannot be proven. Keep the baseline record and #714 rationale intact.
